supporting_chunk_ids: Servicemembers’ Group Life Insurance (SGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0005
units.reason: The context states that you can apply for VGLI within 1 year and 120 days of leaving the military, up to the amount of SGLI coverage you had.

units.text: 如果您在退伍后240天内申请，无需提供健康证明；超过240天则需提交健康证明。

units.reason: The context states that if you sign up within 240 days, you don't need to prove good health; after 240 days, you need to submit evidence of good health.
